root_text: Heard about #HMPV spreading in China? 🤔 It’s a respiratory virus like the flu – not new, but worth keeping an eye on. No vaccine yet, but simple steps like handwashing & avoiding sick contacts help reduce the risk. #StaySafe #PublicHeal
